title: Hurst-Augmented GARCH OOS 測試：WORSE (+1.3%)
description:
## OOS QLIKE：Hurst 能否改善 GARCH？

| 模型 | QLIKE | vs GJR |
|------|-------|--------|
| GJR-GARCH (baseline) | 0.8264 | — |
| Hurst-augmented GJR | 0.8370 | +1.28% |

### 結論
- In-sample Hurst corr=0.336（看似有預測力）
- **OOS QLIKE: WORSE** → In-sample correlation 沒有轉化為 OOS improvement
- Rule 20 提醒：statistical significance ≠ practical significance
